name: Aslaug
subtitle: The Clever
description: Divine the future as you Reflect effects back to the enemy and protect against Disables.
lore: Born the daughter of Sigurd but raised as a peasant, Aslaug eventually became one of Ragnar Lothbrok’s wives for a time. Although capable as a warrior, she is particularly well known for her wit, cleverness, and trickery. She serves as advisor to many of Asgard’s heroes and military leaders—as well as, on occasion, a courier, saboteur, and spy in neighboring realms.
divinity_generator: Gain [30] Divinity when placing a [Buff] on an ally
